Thousand Island Dressing
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, November 30, 2009 - 11:52pm

Ingredients




1 cup mayonnaise
2 tablespoons ketchup
1 tablespoon white vinegar
3 teaspoons sugar
2 teaspoons sweet pickle relish
1 tablespoon finely minced white onions
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
1 teaspoon chili sauce
1 teaspoon minced garlic

Preparation

1 Combine all of the ingredients in a small bowl.  Stir well. 2 Place dressing in a covered container and refrigerate for several hours, stirring occasionally, so that the sugar dissolves and the flavors blend.
